descricao_original: This high magnification electron micrograph shows desmosomes in human epidermis. Desmosomes consist of a dense attachment plaque into which keratin filaments (intermediate filaments) insert. Adhesion proteins extend from the plaque into the intercellular space, where they overlap to provide attachment between the cells. 70,000x
